messages:
omar: Heads up — final pass on the Dedicated GPU buildout checklist. Need owners for a few late items before Thursday cutover. Quick async sync pls :eyes:
lena: I can own the on-site rack power verification and CMC checks. ETA EOD Weds.
raj: I’ll take node imaging + ssh key rollout. Will coordinate with ops for the pubkey rotation window.
sophie: I’ll do the cluster-level NTP/time drift validation and kubelet config diff. Any specific version pinning we need?
omar: thanks @lena @raj @sophie. For pinning — keep kubelet at 1.28.3 for the canary; we should not bump during first 48h.
omar: Owners needed:
- manifest reconcile for GPU SKUs + serials (owner?)
- capacity reservations in the cloud provider (who will run the terraform apply?)
- smoke test scripts to validate perf/latency baselines (owner?)
- fallback routing policy for pod placement if spot pool is depleted (owner?)
maria: I can handle manifest reconcile and serial mapping. I have the vendor CSVs and the internal inventory script.
lena: I can run the smoke perf scripts but need the updated token and model endpoint stub. @infra-bot can you attach the staging endpoint creds?
infra-bot: Attached: staging-client-token (expires in 72h). Also pushed smoke script template to //git/internal/infra/smoke/gpu_latency_v1.sh
raj: I’ll do terraform apply for the reservation but will need a brief CR window. Propose Thu 01:30-02:00 UTC. Is that safe?
sophie: That window works for me for kube-level checks. Add a quick check: run `kubectl get nodes -o wide` and confirm `nvidia.com/gpu` label present.
omar: +1 on Thu 01:30. Raj, please post the `terraform plan` output in this thread before apply. If plan shows any IP changes, we hold.
maria: For smoke tests, I’ll add a lightweight prompt set and a synthetic load generator. Target 95th perc latency < 250ms on short-context runs.
lena: Noted. Also reminder: rack power team needs the final PDU mapping by 18:00 Wed. I’ll post the spreadsheet link shortly.
raj: Quick question — are we pinning quantized models on Dedicated initially, or running fp16? That affects memory footprint and node packing.
omar: Start with q4_0 (8-bit) variant for cost/rack density; have a fallback to fp16 if we see quality regressions. Record this in the rollout doc.
sophie: One more dependency: monitoring alert rule for GPU temperature > 80C should be enabled before canary. Who owns alerting?
maria: I can add the alert and a runbook entry. Will reference the on-call page.
omar: Nice. TL;DR action items and owners:
- Maria: manifest reconcile + smoke test baseline additions
- Raj: terraform plan + apply for reservations (Thu 01:30 UTC)
- Lena: PDU mapping + on-site power verification
- Sophie: kubelet config checks + monitoring alerts
- Omar: rollout doc + fallback policy
Everyone ack? :thumbsup:
lena: 👍
raj: ack. planning to post plan by 01:00 Thu UTC.
sophie: ack
maria: ack
omar: If anything flakes, tag me and @oncall. Thanks all — we’ll call a quick stand if anything blocks during the CR window.
